settings.linker: grow step by step, curved fit from 4 points (version 3)

statement: Tracks found from SPHEREx detections alone. No asteroid catalogue was consulted before this file was locked.
history: Version 1 (24-arcminute patches) removed every dot near a Gaia or WISE star. In these fields the ~10,000 catalogue stars per patch covered almost the whole image, so nothing was left (validation/asteroids/v1/, ledger entry 24). Version 2 removes fixed sources by comparing epochs with each other, as moving-object surveys do, and uses 60-arcminute patches; on six patches it recovered 1 of 3 known asteroids brighter than V 17 and none fainter (validation/asteroids/v2_calibration/, ledger entry 25). Those six patches were then used to tune the linker on known asteroids (version 3: tracks grow step by step and may curve). Version 3 is run blind on six different patches; the tuning patches are not counted in its result.
control: Each field was also linked 8 times after rotating each night's detections by a random angle about the field centre (and mirroring half the nights): the number of tracks that appear by chance.
